question: Stuck for a bit — want to step back and re-frame the approach?
whyHelp:
Here is why this matters right now:
Grinding on the same failing path rarely breaks the loop.
A quick reset — state the goal, list what you have tried — often surfaces the missing piece.

L1.title: Describe the problem in one sentence, without code
L1.body: Step back for a second. Describe the problem in plain English, without any code — what is it actually doing wrong? Often just writing that sentence reveals the fix. If you're stuck, note the last point where things worked and what's changed since.

L2.title: Describe the bug in plain English
L2.body: Describe the bug in plain English, no code. Often the sentence itself reveals the fix. What was the last point it worked?

L3.title: What's actually going wrong?
L3.body: What's actually going wrong, in plain words? Often that's the fix.
